title: What is the term of this agreement?

messages.content: What is the term of this agreement?

Based on **Master-Services-Agreement-2024-Revised.docx**, here is the relevant contractual analysis:

### Key Provision 1

The contract stipulates the following terms: 【Each party shall use at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, but in no event less than reasonable care.】

### Key Provision 2

The contract stipulates the following terms: 【During the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party involved in the performance of Services.】


*Every quote above has been extracted verbatim from Master-Services-Agreement-2024-Revised.docx and verified against the source text.*
